normative_provenance.candidate_terminology_policy: S-C01 candidate terminology is non-normative and absent from every cell.
normative_provenance.source_semantics_policy: Only source syntax, validated fields, validated wildcards, and validated controlled-vocabulary supplements may vary; no concept or Boolean relationship is changed.

field_scope.value: ARC normal Advanced Search Anywhere field: field1=AllField with the exact cell in text1.
field_scope.acceptance_gate: A live P01 must visibly confirm the Advanced Search route, AllField field, exact query echo or retained control, and result URL controls before any translation is accepted.

source_native_draft.term_rendering: Each finite dictionary literal is one double-quoted atom. Concept alternatives are parenthesized OR groups and Boolean nodes are fully parenthesized with uppercase AND/OR.
source_native_draft.phrase_policy: Multiword entries remain ordered quoted phrase candidates; phrase order, punctuation, hyphen normalization, and tokenization are untested.

wildcard.basis: normative dictionary and offline construction; no ARC wildcard validation

acronym_boundary.basis: untested; standalone-token behavior must be validated before acceptance

source_native_draft.parser_status: All nine cells were generated offline from the v4 dictionary. No cell has been submitted to ARC; Boolean parsing, precedence, phrase behavior, rewrite, and query length remain unknown.

paired_term_handling.normative_requirement: Every left/right pair is unordered, in one searchable field, with at most five intervening lexical tokens.
paired_term_handling.draft_transport: G_model, G_structure, C1, and T2 pair cross-products are retained as explicit parenthesized Boolean conjunctions so no literal is lost.
paired_term_handling.why: The current source-free adapter and local domain notes do not establish an ARC-native unordered distance operator or same-field pair semantics. Boolean conjunction is broader than the normative pair relation.
paired_term_handling.future_gate: Validate a compliant ARC-native pair operator or a broader same-field construction that cannot lose an exact pair; otherwise do not submit pair-bearing cells for final use and apply exact matching locally only where retained fields permit it.

diagnostic_publication_date.upper_bound_label: pilot execution-date diagnostic upper bound only; P-001 remains unresolved and this is not a final common cutoff
diagnostic_publication_date.implementation: Adapter exact dates map to ARC month controls and retain an exact-day disposition for retrieved RIS dates; source total remains before any client-side exact-day exclusion.

language.basis: protocol default pending source validation; full-report language remains a later screening/retrieval decision

prohibited_limits.access: not imposed as a discovery restriction; ARC default access=on is the documented all-content route control

controls.ordering_and_page: Adapter predeclares visible Relevance and fixed 20-record pages; current interface evidence is untested in P01.
controls.source_total_cap: Adapter complete mode has fixed MAX_SOURCE_TOTAL=100. P01 does not invoke complete mode; retrieval diagnostic uses the separate pilot cap in p01-execution-plan.md.

controlled_vocabulary.reason: A documented Keyword field is not by itself a genuine controlled vocabulary or accepted indexed-term supplement. P01 must inspect the visible field/record surface without adding descriptors.
controlled_vocabulary.mandatory_rule: Free text remains mandatory. Do not treat generic systems engineering, an unvalidated Keyword field, or local labels as a controlled MBSE substitute.

query_length_and_cell_policy.adapter_ceiling_basis: offline current adapter constant; not an ARC source query-length observation
query_length_and_cell_policy.current_cells: One complete v4 cell per partition; the largest BT2 cell is below the adapter ceiling, so no lossless shard is required for this bundle.
query_length_and_cell_policy.future_split_rule: Only after observing an ARC length limit may a controller prospectively map a lossless stable-DOI union of complete source-native cells and reconcile each cell and union; never silently narrow a block.

lossless_union_rule.identity: No source identifier or union behavior has been observed.
lossless_union_rule.failure: Access, query, control, rewrite, total, page, export, identity, or completeness failure makes the operation total null and imports no prefix.

lossless_union.rationale: The complete dictionary Boolean tree is below the adapter input ceiling; no source query-length limit has been observed and no shard is required.
